name: ui-confirm
prompt: Short soft UI button click, a gentle wooden tap with a quick muted click, clean, dry, no reverb.

name: item-select
prompt: Light pluck of a small metal utensil tapping the rim of a ceramic bowl, bright short tick, close mic.

name: ingredient-spawn
prompt: Soft pop of a fresh vegetable landing on a wooden cutting board, gentle organic thump with a slight bounce.

name: merge-pop
prompt: Juicy wet pop of two soft food items squishing together into one, followed by a brief tiny sparkle shimmer.

name: action-denied
prompt: Short dull double knock on a wooden kitchen door, low and muted, a gentle refusal without harshness.

name: order-serve
prompt: Small brass restaurant service bell ding followed by a plate being set down softly on a counter, bright and satisfying.

name: streak-bonus
prompt: Quick ascending cascade of three small glass chimes with a light kitchen clatter, cheerful and energetic.

name: order-expire
prompt: Gentle descending airy sigh of steam escaping as a pot is lifted off the heat, soft and deflating.

name: discard-item
prompt: Crinkling food wrapper dropped into a metal trash bin, ending with a soft hollow clang.

name: round-win
prompt: Cheerful small restaurant kitchen celebration, happy service bell dings, plates chiming and a short rising sparkle flourish.

name: round-lose
prompt: Gentle disappointed descending phrase on a wooden marimba in a quiet kitchen, soft, warm and sympathetic.

name: timer-tick
prompt: Single quiet mechanical kitchen timer tick, one short dry click, no ring.
